data.name: Sangey
data.gender_notes: Sangey is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sangey is a name of Sanskrit and Hindi origin, derived from the words 'san' meaning joy and 'gey' meaning melodious. It reflects the idea of a joyful and melodious being. In Hinduism, it is also associated with the goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge, music, and arts. The name Sangey carries the meaning “Joyful, Melodious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sangey usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful, melodious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sangey is a name that resonates with the joy and creativity of the divine. It is believed to bring happiness and harmony to the bearer's life, and to inspire a love of music and the arts. In Hinduism, it is also associated with the goddess Saraswati, who embodies the wisdom and knowledge that underlie all creative endeavors.
data.etymology: Sangey belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joyful, Melodious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sangey total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
